title: Closeout summary: Hardening S1 envelope and reference contracts
body:
## Sprint Rollup

Hardening S1 is complete. All six dependency-scoped child tasks are closed and verified: data.result envelopes, domain-specific not-found recovery, workflow ref normalization/didYouMean, unknown-flag suggestions, stable doctor/gate verdict paths under truncation, and installed skill canonical workflow refs.

Closeout checks passed: sprint metrics reported 6 committed / 6 completed / 0 open / 0 carryover; sprint report generated with doctor evidence bw_evidence_832da16b3409c229 and sync evidence bw_evidence_64c0e95e151ef3ac; sprint verification bw_verification_36b1da36211bc369 passed.

Docs were updated for the command reference and hardening status. Workflow and skill docs now require canonical workflow IDs for installed skill adapters, and doctor skills validates source and installed-root workflow refs.
